rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=18, n_iter=600, outer_wall_s=1200, lr=0.0001, unet_c=16, rationale=iter-6: ONE knob -> pretrain_epochs 12 -> 18 (1.5x warm-start budget). KEEP lr=1e-4 (per-scan overfit anchor, iter-3 winner). DIAGNOSIS (numbers, not pixels): iter-3 ep3/lr1e-4 SSIM 0.4880 (PSNR 16.28); iter-4 ep6 0.4957 (+0.0077, PSNR 16.29); iter-5 ep12 0.5081 (+0.0124, PSNR 16.376). The init lever (warm-start pretrain_epochs) is the dominant confirmed lever and is NOT saturating on demo: the gain ACCELERATED 6->12 (+0.0124) vs 3->6 (+0.0077), and PSNR rose monotonically 16.28->16.29->16.376 with NO turn-over. This DIVERGES from the breast n2i sibling, which SATURATED flat (0.9596) at ep12 -- demo (synthetic phantoms, lower-quality init at fixed epochs) still has slope on the init budget where breast does not. n_iter is RULED OUT (iter-2 1200 steps REGRESSED 0.4785->0.4293, per-scan U-Net overfits one noisy scan) and unet_c is the explicitly-warned-against axis (solver design doc: capacity is NOT the lever for this loss; mayo n2i c16->c32 flat 0.9508). So the only lever with demonstrated positive slope is the init budget. LEVER CHOICE: push pretrain_epochs once more (12->18) rather than pivot to the per-scan-anchor axis (seed/grad_clip/lr-sweep) because the iter-5 falsifier (flat at ~0.495 => init saturated => pivot) did NOT fire -- SSIM CLIMBED to 0.5081 with an accelerating slope, so the init lever is still the highest-expected-value move. Chose +6 (12->18, 1.5x) not +12 (12->24, 2x) to keep wall comfortably under 15 min without dropping val_n/n_iter (preserve the val-set + per-scan-budget consistency for clean iter-to-iter SSIM comparison). HYPOTHESIS: more warm-start budget converges the amortized GT-free N2I U-Net init further, lifting SSIM above the 0.5081 iter-5 plateau toward the per-image U-Net N2I ceiling on this 128-view synthetic substrate (~0.51, structurally FBP-bounded so still hr~0 -- the demo n2i ceiling is approach-to-baseline, not headroom). FALSIFIER: if SSIM flattens at ~0.508 (delta < +0.005, i.e. < half the iter-5 gain) the init lever has finally saturated on demo too -- declare the per-image U-Net N2I converged to its ceiling (~0.51) on this synthetic substrate and stop chasing init; iter-7 would then read the noise floor (seed) or accept the U-Net ceiling and lean on the bilateral twin (which clears baseline at hr+0.33 because its 6 params cannot overfit one scan). WALL: warm 18x200=3600 + per-image 6x600=3600 = 7200 steps @ ~0.083 s/step ~= 600 s (iter-5 was 463s at 6000 steps), under the 15-min target, the outer_wall_s=1200 guard, and the 00:30:00 (1800 s) sbatch wall -- no need to drop val_n/n_iter. All other knobs IDENTICAL to iter-5 (train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, n_iter=600, lr=1e-4, unet_c=16).
